reuse.why: Routes the flag through the existing FillHiddenRule 'include' mode of getFillCategories/filterFillCategories, so templates, #fixed and income exclusions stay in shouldFillCategory untouched.

duplication.why: The same `includeHiddenCategories ? 'include' : <default>` mapping is repeated in all six actions instead of being resolved once in a tiny helper.

placement.why: The change lives in actions.ts where the month-wide actions and the fill-selection helpers already are; the RPC types follow via typeof in app.ts.

scope.why: Only the action signatures, one shared args type, a test and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: Clear and minimal with a shared MonthWideArgs type; the six repeated ternaries are a small spot a future rule change must touch in several places.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated flag-to-rule ternary in copyPreviousMonth/setZero/set3MonthAvg/setLastMonthSpending/set12MonthAvg/set6MonthAvg is plain, not disguised.
